reasons.plausibility: Al has very low solubility in refractory BCC alloys and strongly promotes brittle intermetallics (e.g., aluminides with Zr, Hf, Ti), making retention of a single BCC phase and high ductility/strength at 5–10 at.% Al highly unlikely.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-structured, with specific compositions, characterization methods, and quantitative rejection criteria (strength drop >10%, secondary phases, ductility loss).
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core trade-off directly, but its physical implausibility means pursuing it would likely waste resources; a researcher would be better served by a more viable alloying strategy.
